text: AI is changing the world of creativity. Today, machines can produce art, write stories, and compose music that sounds almost human. For example, AI algorithms can create paintings in the style of famous artists, write poems based on a few words, or generate a song melody. Some people are amazed by these results, while others worry. The main question is whether machine creativity can ever match human creativity. Human art comes from emotions, memories, and personal experience. AI, on the other hand, works by finding patterns in large amounts of data. So, while AI can imitate creativity, it may not truly feel or understand what it creates.
